title: Reproducible Native Paths
objective: Publish production native-kernel metadata without checkout-local paths and define a safe path-remapping plan for release-native builds

oracles: Published index relocation and source-tree privacy tests

handoff.summary: Published production native-kernel indexes now expose only portable logical source identities. Focused tests reject absolute checkout disclosure, nonportable logical keys, and unexpected record metadata.
risks: Generated wrappers, native compiler identities/provenance, and most current linked native binaries still contain absolute checkout or dependency-source paths; this lane deliberately does not claim byte-reproducible native artifacts.
next_steps: Implement the staged TODO plan: logical compiler provenance, canonical native staging with identity-bound deterministic path maps, then independent binary comparison and path scans on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
